title: Serpent Over the City
description: A massive serpent with orange and green scales coils through a dramatic sunset sky, its body held by a large disembodied hand. Below lies a glowing cityscape with illuminated buildings, while on the right a green-skinned female face with black tears merges into a dripping stone wall covered in skulls.
